hook: Stand Still: Moses at the Edge of the Sea
text: The people saw Pharaoh's army coming, and they were very afraid. Moses said to the people, Don't be afraid. Stand still, and see the salvation of the Lord, which he will work for you today. The Lord will fight for you, and you shall be still. Moses stretched out his hand over the sea, and the Lord caused the sea to go back by a strong east wind all night, and the waters were divided.
